thread:
emily (CSM): Quick flag for Skyline Inc. QBR prep — token burn shot up after their search team launched a bulk reindex. Can we assemble short mitigations for the deck?
omar (Account Lead): yep. Do we have exact spend delta?
riley (Finance): baseline monthly = 8.2M tokens. Last 7 days jumped by 6.1M tokens. Projected next-quarter usage if unchanged = ~38M tokens. Estimated incremental cost this quarter ~ $10k vs committed.
emily (CSM): yikes. They were on a trial embedding overload. We need a triage runbook: immediate (alerts/quotas), short (routing/cache), and medium (dim tuning + batching).
devin (Eng): immediate: enable daily budget alerts and a soft quota on embeddings. Short: route non-search traffic to embed-lite model and turn on prefix caching for search queries. Medium: run embedding-dim experiment on lower-importance indices, introduce async batch workers for large jobs. I can push a canary in the next few hours.
maya (Enablement): I can host a 20-min workshop with their SRE + data team to run sampling and show quality vs cost tradeoffs. Available Tue 9am PT.
emily (CSM): please capture two slides: 1) action items we will execute in next 72h; 2) forecast scenarios post-optimization.
riley (Finance): I'll add scenario table: current, route+cache, route+cache+dim-tune. Need numbers for assumed token reduction and cost per 1M for lite.
devin (Eng): bench numbers: lite embeds ~ -25% tokens on average; cost per 1M tokens for lite = $45, standard = $115 (internal test env). I'll run a 5k-call sample against Skyline data and post results.
emily (CSM): Also want to show a safety plan for their execs: auto-fallback policy + quota enforcement so they don't get surprised. Can someone paste a sample fallback policy snippet?
devin (Eng): sample fallback policy:
```
policy: {
  route: [ { name: "embed-lite", weight: 0.1 }, { name: "embed-standard", weight: 0.9 } ],
  on_quality_drop: { revert_to: "embed-standard", notify: ["emily", "omar"], cooldown: 600 }
}
```
I'll convert to Console JSON after the experiment.
emily (CSM): alerts-bot - paste recent budget alerts and confirm whether Skyline's Slack webhook is wired.
alerts-bot: recent alerts for skyline_inc:
- 2026-03-05T12:01:22Z threshold $3,500/day (triggered) - embedding batch job spiked
- 2026-03-06T08:34:10Z threshold $4,000/day (escalated) - repeated batches
Webhook to #skyline-alerts = true
omar (Account Lead): Can we temporarily throttle large embedding jobs until we validate the lite model?
devin (Eng): yes. sample quota via API:
POST /v1/accounts/skyline_inc/quotas
{ "resource": "embeddings", "daily_limit": 600000 }
I'll set a canary throttle at 10% of traffic now.
maya (Enablement): for the QBR deck Ill prepare: 1) a one-slide playbook (immediate wins), 2) a short demo script for live validation during the QBR, and 3) a customer-facing checklist.
riley (Finance): I'll produce a graph with three scenario bands and simple $ per M token lines. Put placeholder numbers and mark assumptions clearly.
emily (CSM): action list: omar schedule QBR (Thu preferred), maya run enablement Tue 9am PT, devin run canary + post metrics, riley update forecast slides. I'll consolidate and send a deck draft by EOD Tue.
omar (Account Lead): sounds good. One more ask: include an escalation bullet for migrations (if they choose to move heavy jobs off-peak windows).
devin (Eng): noted. starting canary now, quick logs:
[canary] route=embed-lite weight=0.1 status=started ts=2847654400
[canary] sample 2k calls: observed -21% token usage for embeddings, latency within SLO
emily (CSM): perfect. thanks team. I'll draft the immediate-playbook slide and share the deck link here.
maya (Enablement): will prep the short script and a set of metrics the customer can look at to validate quality.
riley (Finance): drafting numbers now, will update when devin posts full results.
emily (CSM): aim to finalize canary and deck by Tue EOD so QBR is clean on Thu. Any blockers?
omar (Account Lead): none from my side. Proceed.
